intro.title: Hi! I'm Mini Robert
intro.text: Your navigation assistant. I'm a little solar rover and I roll right behind you, everywhere on the Moon.

intro.title: Your mission
intro.text: You crashed at the lunar south pole. To get home you must:
steps: 🫧 SURVIVE: oxygen, cold, water and food
🔧 REPAIR the rocket and make fuel
🚀 LAUNCH home inside a return window

intro.title: Ask me anything
intro.text: Press E next to me, or click / tap me. I carry the whole guide: controls, items, map, enemies, events, menus — and I always know what you should do next.

intro.title: Your first step
intro.text: Follow the yellow TUTORIAL box at the top and the MISSION bar at the bottom. If you get lost, come talk to me. Let's go, Commander!

areas.title: The goal
areas.sub: What this game is and how you win

points.d: Your ship, the Selene-7, crashed at the Moon's south pole. The antenna broke and the fuel tanks emptied.
ARIA is the ship's AI (story messages). I, Mini Robert, am your guide. Mission Control on Earth talks to you once you rebuild a relay.
Collect ice, regolith, scrap and metal with ACTION (SPACE).
Keep oxygen, health, water, energy and sanity up. Go back to the habitat to refill O2 and rest.
Craft modules and tools, then repair the rocket's 6 subsystems.
Ice → water → electrolysis → hydrogen + oxygen → liquefier → LH2 and LOX in the rocket tanks.
Launch inside a return window with enough fuel. That's the ending!
Seal a leak: hold E with 1 Sealant kit (2 Scrap + 1 Metal).
Collect 6 ice in the dark Shadowed Crater.
Produce 3 kg of liquid hydrogen (LH2).
Repair the rocket's Structure and Power to 70%.
Design and launch the CubeSat relay.
All subsystems at 90% and the tanks filled for the next window.
Launch inside a return window.
No aliens. Only real lunar hazards (cold, heat, radiation, meteorites).
Moderate aliens at night.
Aggressive aliens, darker nights, fewer resources.
Easy: less O2 and wear, fewer hazards, cold hurts much slower, extra kits. Hard: everything faster and harsher.
Move. SHIFT runs (costs energy).
Gather / hit with the item in your hand. In build mode: place.
Interact with the closest thing (doors, chests, stations, me). HOLD E to seal leaks and repair.
Inventory and crafting.
C opens/closes build mode, Q switches the module to place.
V puts the space suit on/off. X drops 1 item (SHIFT+X the whole stack).

areas.title: Buttons & screen
areas.sub: What every bar and box means

points.d: Suit O2. Refills next to the habitat. At 0 you suffocate.
At 0 you die and respawn at the base (your items stay in a bag where you fell).
Drops while you work and run. Rest inside the habitat.
Drink inside the habitat with the suit OFF (uses tank water).
Drops in the dark, alone and in danger. Light, food and rest bring it back.
Suit integrity. Repair it at the Workshop with a Sealant kit.
Blue = cold, orange = hot. Stay too long in a color and you lose health.
Distance and direction to your next goal (leak, crater, capsule…). Follow the arrow.
Day number and time. Night is colder and darker.
BAT = battery, LH2 / LOX = rocket fuel tanks, +x/s = energy coming in.
Your current main mission. Tap it to see all missions.
Slots 1–5: the item in your hand decides what you gather and how fast.
World map with fog; zones you visited are revealed.
Event history · status of every module.
Rocket checklist · real NASA mission history you unlock.
Fullscreen · Pause.
Limited pockets. Water does not use slots: it lives in the habitat tank.
Hand recipes. Bigger recipes need the Workshop or Furnace.
Drag or click suits, capes and gear onto your character.
Tools, modules, gear, Bridge Kit, rover, farm. Also repairs the suit.
Bakes regolith into insulation and hot meals. With power it also makes O2 and metal on its own.
✓ = ready to craft. Grey = locked. Red outline = missing materials.
Tap any ingredient to see where it comes from: zone, caves, capsules, farm or recipe.
20 slots. Machines (rover, drill, bioreactor) drop their output here.
Repair subsystems, load fuel, check return windows, launch.
Pick parts within mass and size limits to rebuild contact with Earth.
Zones, your position, historic sites.
Everything you have discovered.

In the dark Shadowed Crater. Melt it at the habitat (E) into water.

Wreckage around the base and capsules. Kits, tools, modules.

Glowing moss in the crater and rift. Food, and plants for the hydroponic farm.
Better tools gather more per swing. Some nodes need a specific tool.
Hit aliens and androids.
Mandatory outside: without it the vacuum kills you in seconds.
Holds ~10 °C. Needed in the Frozen Basin.
Caps heat at ~30 °C. Needed in the Scorch Fields.
Radiation, damage and movement protection.
Restore health, sanity and water; hot meals also clear Cold.
Heal / remove fatigue and panic.
Baked potato, Bread and Space cookies: grow crops and cook them at the Furnace.
Power by day, storage for the night.

areas.title: Effects on you
areas.sub: Side effects and how to fix them

points.d: Slower and loses health after a few seconds. Fix: habitat, Thermal suit, hot meal.
Loses health in the sun at peaks. Fix: shade, habitat, Reflective cape.
Only during flares. Fix: habitat or Regolith shield.
From working and running. Fix: rest in the habitat or a Stimulant.
Fix: habitat or food.
Drink inside with the suit off · refill O2 next to the habitat.
In the dark near danger. Fix: light.
Fix: lit towers, rest or food.
Fix: habitat, Stimulant or food.
You wake up at the base. Your lost items wait in a bag where you fell: press E on it.
Panels only work in the sun; batteries carry you through the night.
Lunar dust lowers panel power. Clean them with E or build the EDS Dust Shield.
Below 30% battery at night, electrolysis, liquefier, furnace and drill pause.
Melt at the habitat (E).
Water → H2 + O2 gas (needs power).
Gas → LH2 + LOX in the rocket tanks. Best mix 6:1 (LOX:LH2).
Press E on it to choose a material. It drives to where that material is, mines 3, drives back and drops them in the chest. Own power, day and night.
Inside the crater: ice into the chest (or your pockets).
Uses water: habitat O2 and a ration every 2 min.
Plant seeds or algae (E), WATER them (E, 2 kg from the tank), wait, then HARVEST (E). Dry crops stop growing.
HOLD E with a Sealant kit on a damaged module.
A green ^ means you can afford a level-up: press E.
Potato and Wheat seeds come in supply capsules and the base chest. Harvest gives 1 seed back.
Hold the seed in your hand (or any seed) and press E on a Hydroponic farm.
A blinking blue drop means thirsty: press E to water (2 kg). One watering lasts ~1 minute.
When the plants turn gold, press E to cut them.
2 Potatoes = Baked potato · 3 Wheat = Bread · 2 Wheat + 1 Algae = Space cookies.
Propulsion, power, thermal, communications, attitude control, structure. Repair each with materials.
Without it communications cap below 100%.
Fill LH2 and LOX; LH2 slowly boils off, so don't wait too long.
Only certain days line up for a return. The rocket panel shows the next one.
Everything ready + inside a window = go home!
Short exploration with choices and loot.
Fit the right parts inside the limits.
Hit the perfect 6:1 ratio for a side mission.
Capsules, flares, towers, aliens, crystals… extra rewards.
Pop up as you play.
Real history unlocked by your actions.
Always carry 1–2 Sealant kits for leaks.
Bring ice home before night: water = drinking, O2 and fuel.
Craft it early if you go out at night or to the crater.
Turn back at half oxygen: the way home counts too.
Full pockets stop you gathering. Store extras.
Light towers around the base protect you at night.
